quest.title: Autonomous Mechanical Energy Source: Conclusion
quest.description: With Hosseini's help, you successfully defeated that unique autonomous machine. Inform him of the good news.

dialogues.speaker: Hosseini
dialogues.text: How did it go, Traveler? Did Pursina's Spikes come in handy?

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: Very good! We did not labor in vain, then. I suppose this commission has also drawn to a close.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: As for this anomalous Ruin Grader model, its functions seem vastly different from your ordinary wandering Ruin Guards or Ruin Hunters. The entire thought process behind their design was superior by leaps and bounds.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: However, similar machines are not common. My guess is that this might have been some sort of experimental model.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: Why did its initial creator make it in the first place?

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: Does this mean that the ancients' skill in making autonomous machines is greater than we estimated? How very fascinating.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: If I could take it apart, we'd be sure to make some revolutionary discoveries...

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: Traveler, if you have the time, could you take me to see the remains of that anomalous model?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: There's not much left of it.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: What? Did you destroy its frame completely?

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: Agh, Archon... What a colossal waste! No, it's a colossal error!

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: *sigh* It's all my fault. I should have reminded you beforehand...

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: Ah, what a shame, what a shame! It could have been a historical find in the field of ancient technical studies... And now there's nothing left to even take back as samples.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: No, no, it's alright. You weren't aware of the academic value it held in the first place, so you can't be blamed for acting as you did.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: It was I who, as the person who knew its value, should've reminded you, but did not. I was remiss in my duties, not you in yours.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: This trip really was a struggle from start to finish. First, I couldn't secure long-term residence in Ritou... and now I've allowed such a momentous discovery to go to waste...

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: Ah, it's all water under the bridge now. Let's be positive, shall we? At the very least, I did manage to repair my set of Pursina's Spikes, and even managed to test their functionality.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: Ah, I truly do look up to Pursina and Ayesha, who were able to make such precise instruments. Their wonderful creations should never have been allowed to waste away inside our storehouses.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: ...You know what? If my research here in Inazuma really can't proceed, I might as well change my research topic to Pursina's Spikes.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: If the Akademiya ends up taking notice of this subject of study, and if my research paper does end up being published...

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: Haha, I'll definitely write your name into the acknowledgments.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Let's hope I actually understand your report.

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: Well, we'll see, won't we?

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: I hope that your future travels will avail you as much as our cooperation this time has.

choices.text: Well, if you had told me earlier...

response.speaker: Hosseini
response.text: Indeed, this problem arose from my failure to consider all the possibilities. Alas, it is all too late now.
